# sendio_webhook (Resource)

A webhook endpoint that receives send.io events, signed with `signing_secret`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sendio_webhook" "events" {
  endpoint = "https://example.com/webhooks/sendio"
  events   = ["email.delivered", "email.bounced", "email.complained"]
  format   = "sendio"
  headers = {
    "X-Environment" = "production"
  }
}

output "webhook_signing_secret" {
  value     = sendio_webhook.events.signing_secret
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `endpoint` (String) Public HTTPS URL that receives the events.
- `events` (Set of String) Events to deliver, for example `email.delivered` and `email.bounced`.

### Optional

- `format` (String) Payload format: `sendio` (default), or a provider format (`postmark`, `sendgrid`, `mailgun`, `mailchimp`, `brevo`, `mailjet`) for code written against that provider.
- `headers` (Map of String) Extra request headers sent with every delivery, `{name = value}` (at most 50).
- `status` (String) `enabled` (default) or `disabled`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the webhook was created.
- `id` (String) Webhook id.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret (`whsec_...`) for checking delivery signatures. Rotating it outside Terraform shows up on the next refresh.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sendio_webhook.events 0b8e5f3c-6a43-4a5e-9a51-0f4c2d7e9b10
```
